stem.text: What will happen as a result of the blood pressure in the right ventricle becoming higher than the blood pressure in the right atrium?

A.text: The semilunar valve in the aorta will close.

B.text: The semilunar valve in the pulmonary artery will close.

C.text: The left atrioventricular valve will close.

D.text: The right atrioventricular valve will close.
